name: english-paper-assistant
description: Paste an English paragraph (up to 10,000 words), then ask questions about it. Runs 100% locally with a React UI and a Node.js backend using a local AI question-answering model.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
